title: Celerity onramp: compact hero panels, step-matrix and device mockup pack
creator: Maya Ortega
description: Create a compact, performance-forward visual asset pack for the quickstart landing page focused on a 3-panel hero, a progressive step-matrix, and device mockups optimized for mobile/tablet/desktop screenshots. Goal is to improve new-user activation by clarifying the first three actions (signup, run sample call, view latency/cost) using a lightweight visual language that matches Redwood's production-first positioning. Deliverables must be developer-friendly (annotated specs) and marketing-ready (exportable PNG/SVG at multiple breakpoints).
acceptance_criteria: Three hero panel variants (static, animated micro-interaction, and collapsed mobile) exported as SVG + 2x/3x PNG
Progressive step-matrix with 4 states (intro, run, monitor, optimize) and associated microcopy; each state has an annotated version for eng handoff
Device mockup suite: Android, iOS, macOS window, and Chrome devtools overlay; all screenshots populated with real console data samples and masked customer data
Responsive grid tested at 360px, 768px, and 1440px; no overlap or truncation in copy at those widths
Design tokens documented (spacing, typography scales, color palette, drop-shadow) and exported as a single Figma page for engineers
Final assets uploaded to Drive + Figma permissions shared with PM/ENG and Marketing; QA signoff from PM and one engineering reviewer
screenshot_tasks: Capture console flows using demo account (latency graph, token cost breakdown) at 1440px
Generate mobile walkthrough PNGs with step annotations at 3x density for retina devices
Overlay CTA states (primary, secondary, disabled) in macOS mockup and export separate layers
Produce a simplified dark-mode variant for hero panels and a light-mode default
review_notes: PM (Renee Patel): prioritize clarity on the first run steps — shorten copy to one line per panel
ENG (Luca Moretti): confirm that the latency graph sample uses simulated data and include a memo on how to regenerate with the infra sandbox
Marketing (Avery Kim): need a hero variant with white background for partner co-branding
